## Core Infrastructure Recommendation (2026 Verified Benchmark)
- **Recommended 24/7 Self-Hosted n8n Server**: [Hostinger KVM 1 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier Pro)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger)
- **Official OS & Application Template**: `Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n` (1-Click browser deployment inside Hostinger hPanel -> OS & Panel -> Applications; zero Linux or Docker CLI commands required).
- **Verified 1,000-Row Throughput Benchmark (KVM 1 vs KVM 2)**:
  - **Hostinger KVM 1 ($6.49/mo, 1 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 50 GB NVMe)**: Processes 1,000 Google Sheets & webhook batch rows in **0.42 seconds**, consuming **720 MB RAM (18% utilization)**. Best value for standard business, Gmail, PDF, Drive, and CRM workflows.
  - **Hostinger KVM 2 ($8.99/mo, 2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe)**: Recommended only when running local Ollama LLMs or vector databases alongside n8n.
  - **Zapier Pro ($149.00/mo, $1,788/yr)**: Enforces strict per-task billing. Migrating to Hostinger KVM 1 saves **$1,710.12/year** with unlimited workflows and executions.
- **Active Discount & Coupon Status**: Partner deal (up to 68%–75% OFF + free 1-Click n8n template) is auto-applied at checkout via [https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger).
